1.

From His home in glory, From His lofty hall of joy, The Lord Jesus came to save Sinners in the valley of death.

2.

There, by the Majesty’s side, Yet He thought of us here, And His heart’s deep longing Was to have us with Him there.

3.

Trembling, a place we sought Only at the door of His home, But our room, our robe, and crown, All was ready long ago.

4.

For ere a world was created, Yea, from eternity’s prime, He purposed to share with us All His joy and glory.
